defs.d: A table, frame, or case, in past centuries usually with a sloping top but now usually with a flat top, for the use of writers and readers. It often has a drawer or repository underneath.

A reading table or lectern to support the book from which the liturgical service is read, differing from the pulpit from which the sermon is preached; also (especially in the United States), a pulpit. Hence, used symbolically for the clerical profession.
To shut up, as in a desk; to treasure.
To equip with a desk or desks.
An act of climbing.
The act of getting to somewhere more elevated.
To ascend; rise; to go up.
defs.ex: Prices climbed steeply.

defs.d: To mount; to move upwards on.
defs.ex: Climbing a tree

defs.d: An outer garment covering the upper torso and arms.Wp
A covering of material, such as paint.Wp
To cover with a coating of some material.
defs.ex: The frying pan was coated with a layer of non-stick material, making it easier to wash.

defs.d: To cover like a coat.
Comparison.
An instruction or command that compares two values.
To assess the similarities and differences between two or more things ["to compare X with Y"]. Having made the comparison of X with Y, one might have found it similar to Y or different from Y.
defs.ex: Compare the tiger's coloration with that of the zebra.

defs.d: To declare two things to be similar in some respect ["to compare X to Y"].
defs.ex: Astronomers have compared comets to dirty snowballs.

defs.d: Error, mistake.
An item (or kind of item) of merchandise with negative value; an unwanted good.
Unfavorable; negative; not good.
defs.ex: Abducting children is bad for mothers.

defs.d: Not suitable or fitting.
defs.ex: Do you think it is a bad idea to confront him directly?

defs.d: Badly.
defs.ex: I didn't do too bad in the last exam.

defs.d: To be strong; to have power (over).
(auxiliary) To be able; can.
The flesh (muscle tissue) of an animal used as food.
defs.ex: A large portion of domestic meat production comes from animals raised on factory farms.

defs.d: A type of meat, by anatomic position and provenance.
defs.ex: The butchery's profit rate on various meats varies greatly.

defs.d: The international mile: a unit of length precisely equal to 1.609344 kilometers established by treaty among Anglophone nations in 1959, divided into 5,280 feet or 1,760 yards.
Any of several customary units of length derived from the 1593 English statute mile of 8 furlongs, equivalent to 5,280 feet or 1,760 yards of various precise values.
An area of level ground.
A note played a semitone lower than a natural, denoted by the symbol ♭ placed after the letter representing the note (e.g., B♭) or in front of the note symbol (e.g. ♭♪).
To make a flat call; to call without raising.
To become flat or flattened; to sink or fall to an even surface.
Having no variations in height.
defs.ex: The land around here is flat.

defs.d: (voice) Without variations in pitch.
To lose remembrance of.
defs.ex: I have forgotten most of the things I learned in school.

defs.d: To unintentionally not do, neglect.
defs.ex: I forgot to buy flowers for my wife at our 14th wedding anniversary.

defs.d: The frozen, crystalline state of water that falls as precipitation.
Any similar frozen form of a gas or liquid.
To have snow fall from the sky.
defs.ex: It is snowing.

defs.d: To hoodwink someone, especially by presenting confusing information.
A participant in a group of sporting activities which includes track and field, road running, cross country running and racewalking.
defs.ex: She's the first athlete in her sport to obtain a corporate sponsor.

defs.d: A person who actively participates in physical sports, especially with great skill; a sportsperson.
To extol or honour in a solemn manner.
defs.ex: to celebrate the name of the Most High

defs.d: To honour by rites, by ceremonies of joy and respect, or by refraining from ordinary business; to observe duly.
defs.ex: to celebrate a birthday

defs.d: A band worn around the waist to hold clothing to one's body (usually pants), hold weapons (such as a gun or sword), or serve as a decorative piece of clothing.
defs.ex: As part of the act, the fat clown's belt broke, causing his pants to fall down.

defs.d: A band used as a restraint for safety purposes, such as a seat belt.
defs.ex: Keep your belt fastened; this is going to be quite a bumpy ride.

defs.d: To encircle.
defs.ex: The small town was belted by cornfields in all directions.

defs.d: To fasten a belt on.
defs.ex: Edgar belted himself in and turned the car's ignition.

defs.d: In a contrary direction to.
defs.ex: It is hard work to swim against the current.

defs.d: In physical opposition to; in collision with.
defs.ex: The rain pounds against the window.

defs.d: By the time that (something happened); before.
(reflexive pronoun) it; A thing as the object of a verb or preposition that also appears as the subject
defs.ex: The door closed by itself

defs.d: It; used to intensify the subject, especially to emphasize that it is the only participant in the predicate
defs.ex: The door itself is quite heavy.

defs.d: (usually in the plural) That which is deserved or merited; a just punishment or reward
To be impelled or driven forward by the action of wind upon sails, as a ship on water; to be impelled on a body of water by steam or other power.
To move through or on the water; to swim, as a fish or a waterfowl.
A tool used for digging; a pickaxe.
A tool for unlocking a lock without the original key; a lock pick, picklock.
To grasp and pull with the fingers or fingernails.
defs.ex: Don't pick at that scab.

defs.d: To harvest a fruit or vegetable for consumption by removing it from the plant to which it is attached; to harvest an entire plant by removing it from the ground.
defs.ex: It's time to pick the tomatoes.

defs.d: Any of various eight-legged, predatory arthropods, of the order Araneae, most of which spin webs to catch prey.
A program which follows links on the World Wide Web in order to gather information.
To move like a spider.
To cover a surface like a cobweb.
A small house.
A seasonal home of any size or stature, a recreational home or a home in a remote location.
defs.ex: Most cottages in the area were larger and more elaborate than my home.

defs.d: To stay at a seasonal home, to go cottaging.
(of men) To have homosexual sex in a public lavatory; to practice cottaging.
A building (or section of a building) used to store a car or cars, tools and other miscellaneous items.
(20th century) A place where cars are serviced and repaired.
To store in a garage.
defs.ex: We garaged the convertible during the monsoon months.

defs.d: To furnish with decorations.
defs.ex: We decorated the Christmas tree with tinsel and baubles.

defs.d: To improve the appearance of an interior of, as a house, room, or office.
defs.ex: There's some paint left over from when we decorated the guest bedroom.

defs.d: To evoke an intense interest or attraction in someone.
defs.ex: The flickering TV fascinated the cat.

defs.d: To make someone hold motionless; to spellbind.
defs.ex: We were fascinated by the potter's skill.

defs.d: Having interesting qualities; captivating; attractive.
Closeness of appearance to something else.
The relation of sharing properties.
defs.ex: Hardly is there a similarity detected between two or three facts, than men hasten to extend it to all. — Sir W. Hamilton.

defs.d: To engage in political activity; politick.
A methodology and activities associated with running a government, an organization, or a movement.
The profession of conducting political affairs.
defs.ex: He made a career out of politics.

defs.d: To hurt or sting.
defs.ex: After being hit with a pitch, the batter exclaimed "Ouch, my arm smarts!"

defs.d: To cause a smart or sting in.
Property; possession
Duty; place; office
A figure formed by two rays which start from a common point (a plane angle) or by three planes that intersect (a solid angle).
defs.ex: the angle between lines A and B

defs.d: The measure of such a figure. In the case of a plane angle, this is the ratio (or proportional to the ratio) of the arc length to the radius of a section of a circle cut by the two rays, centered at their common point. In the case of a solid angle, this is the ratio of the surface area to the square of the radius of the section of a sphere.
defs.ex: The angle between lines A and B is π/4 radians, or 45 degrees.

defs.d: (often in the passive) To place (something) at an angle.
defs.ex: The roof is angled at 15 degrees.

defs.d: To change direction rapidly.
defs.ex: The five ball angled off the nine ball but failed to reach the pocket.

defs.d: The act of criticising; a critical judgment passed or expressed
defs.ex: The politician received a lot of public criticism for his controversial stance on the issue.

defs.d: A critical observation or detailed examination and review.
To make somebody able (to do, or to be, something); to give sufficient ability or power to do or to be; to give strength or ability to.
To affirm; to make firm and strong.
(heading) To interact socially.
(heading) To interact antagonistically.
The whole of something; the entirety.
An uncastrated horse; a stallion.
(sometimes postpositive) Whole; complete.
defs.ex: We had the entire building to ourselves for the evening.

defs.d: Having a smooth margin without any indentation.
A person who obtains things by force; a thug or bully.
defs.ex: They were doing fine until they encountered a bunch of toughs from the opposition.

defs.d: To endure.
To toughen.
Strong and resilient; sturdy.
defs.ex: The tent, made of tough canvas, held up to many abuses.

defs.d: (of food) Difficult to cut or chew.
defs.ex: To soften a tough cut of meat, the recipe suggested simmering it for hours.

defs.d: A moon or other smaller body orbiting a larger one.
defs.ex: A spent upper stage is a derelict satellite.

defs.d: A man-made apparatus designed to be placed in orbit around a celestial body, generally to relay information, data etc. to Earth.
defs.ex: Many telecommunication satellites orbit at 36000km above the equator.

defs.d: To transmit by satellite.
The process of keeping (something or someone) safe.
defs.ex: Raincoats give protection from rain.

defs.d: The state of being safe.
